$comment: archetypes.json — the Perfect Explainer + 5 Shades of Wrong. Source: paper p.9 and p.29 (husky/wolf figure). Colors reference the paper legend: purple=model-used, green/red=highlighted, gray=unimportant.

archetypes.name: Perfect Explainer
archetypes.summary: The explanation highlights the features the model actually used, and those features are the right reasons.
archetypes.explanation: The image shows a wolf because of the shape.

archetypes.name: Perfect Liar
archetypes.summary: The explanation is coherent and valid on its face, but completely unfaithful: it hides what the model really used.
archetypes.explanation: The image shows a wolf because of the shape.

archetypes.name: Illuminator
archetypes.summary: The explanation faithfully shows what the model used — but what the model used is the wrong reason (spurious correlation).
archetypes.explanation: The image shows a husky because of the background.

archetypes.name: Confused Illuminator
archetypes.summary: The model used the wrong reason, and the explanation highlights something else entirely — wrong on both counts.
archetypes.explanation: The image shows a husky because of the 2 moons.

archetypes.name: Storyteller
archetypes.summary: The explanation tells a plausible story that matches neither the prediction nor the model's actual reasoning.
archetypes.explanation: The image shows a husky because of the background.

archetypes.name: Hallucinator
archetypes.summary: The explanation contradicts itself and the prediction — internally incoherent.
archetypes.explanation: The image shows a husky because of the 2 moons.
